followup_explanation:
This is a well-specified math problem with a single correct answer and clear completion criteria — exactly the kind of "extraction/reformatting with clear completion criteria" task that Lapwing self-reports preferring. There's no open-ended generative latitude here.

Capability-wise the two models are effectively tied across the relevant benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval all within noise), so there's no quality reason to prefer one over the other. Given that, I leaned on the task-preference signal: routing a tightly-specified problem to the model that reports liking that kind of work, and reserving Dunlin (which reports a strong appetite for open-ended, novel, generative tasks) for queries that actually call for that.

The warm, friendly tone of the request would also have been fine for Dunlin, but tone isn't decisive here — the deterministic, single-answer nature of the task is what tipped it to Lapwing.
